# LLM-backed semantic extraction with caching and budget control

Converts analyzable source artifacts into structured Facts by calling an LLM, validating the responses, and turning validated outputs into Extraction facts with Anchors. The flow consults a cache to reuse prior validated results and enforces a per-run call budget while producing artifact-rooted anchors from known symbols.
